items.title: Govt unveils offer for sale to dilute LIC stake
items.description: The Centre has announced an Offer for Sale in Life Insurance Corporation of India.  This issue will open for non-retail investors on Tuesday and retail investors on Wednesday.  The divestment includes a base offer of 2.5% with an additional 4% greenshoe option.  The floor price for the Offer for Sale is fixed at ₹382 per share.  This move aids the insurer in meeting minimum public shareholding norms ahead of schedule.

items.title: These large-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of more than 20%
items.description: It was after quite some time that market breadth, always a better indicator of underlying sentiment, was positive for a few trading sessions in a row. This is what needs to be watched, rather than the movement of the Nifty or Sensex. In fact, for the next few sessions, it is critical to look at market breadth because the indices will give confusing signals, especially at the start and end of each session.

items.title: Promoter ownership climbs to two-year high despite persistent FII selling
items.description: Indian promoters significantly boosted their stock purchases in the June quarter. This action drove their ownership in listed companies to a two-year peak. Meanwhile, foreign institutional investors reduced their holdings to a fourteen-year low. Domestic investors absorbed much of the foreign sell-off, reaching an all-time high. This trend highlights growing domestic participation in Indian equity markets.

items.title: Stocks in news: Paytm, LIC, Airtel, BSE, and ONGC
items.description: Markets extended gains on Monday, driven by easing oil prices and strong quarterly earnings.  Paytm's parent company sees investors selling shares worth up to Rs 2,002 crore.  The government will offer shares in LIC to non-retail investors starting Tuesday.  Airtel, ONGC, and BSE will announce their first quarter results today.  ONGC's petroleum facility will reserve half its capacity for strategic reserves.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The Indian market began the week with strong momentum and expects continued positive sentiment. Encouraging first-quarter earnings and easing crude oil prices are supporting this upward trend. Investors will closely watch the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy meeting for further market direction. Developments in the US-Iran conflict and ongoing earnings season also remain key focus areas. Foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutional investors showed net buying activity on Friday.

items.title: New closing auction triggers confusion, sparks late Nifty swings
items.description: Market participants faced confusion during the new auction system's debut.  Indices and stock values diverged significantly, catching traders by surprise.  The new system determines closing prices through a separate auction process.  This change aims to create more robust closing prices for derivatives.  Tuesday's derivatives expiry will be a key test for the new system.

items.title: Stock Radar: Hero MotoCorp stock breaks out from a Flag pattern; time to buy?
items.description: Hero MotoCorp has broken out of a bullish Flag pattern on weekly charts, supported by strong volumes, positive technical indicators and sector strength. Analysts expect the stock to climb towards Rs 5,820 in the coming months, with a stop-loss at Rs 5,170.

items.title: Credit to tech infrastructure sector doubles in two years
items.description: Bank loans for India's technology infrastructure sector have doubled in two years. This growth reflects India's position as a global hub for data centers. Loans to IT services and digital infrastructure rose significantly year on year. This expansion is driven by data centers, GCCs, and IT enabled services. These segments are now showing robust growth in bank credit.

items.title: Sensex rises over 100 points, but Nifty50 slips near 24,600. Here’s why
items.description: The Indian stock market witnessed a mixed session on Tuesday as the Sensex rose over 100 points while the Nifty 50 dropped over 150 points to trade near 24,600. The divergence follows volatility from the newly introduced Closing Auction Session framework on the NSE amid widespread losses in sectoral indices.

items.title: FIIs build a new Banking XI without the usual heavyweights. Will the big banks return?
items.description: Foreign investors reduced stakes in large banks during the June quarter. They simultaneously increased holdings in several mid-sized and smaller private lenders. This shift reflects a preference for banks with specific growth triggers and fundamentals. Large banks still offer strong franchises and reasonable valuations for investors. The rotation depends on future earnings and valuation evolution.

items.title: Nalco among 5 stocks that closed above VWAP, signaling bullish shift
items.description: On August 3, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied over 2% relative to their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), and a shift above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which it was traded throughout the day, with the average being weighted by trading volume. This occurrence is often interpreted as a potential bullish signal by traders and investors. This potentially indicates positive sentiment in the market.

items.title: SBI Funds Management shares in focus after first earnings since IPO; net profit jumps 3% to Rs 873 crore
items.description: SBI Funds Management reported a 3.3% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 873 crore for Q1 FY27, its first quarterly result post-listing. Revenue from operations grew 15.2%, while mutual fund QAAUM reached Rs 12.6 trillion to retain market leadership.

items.title: LIC shares tumble 8% as OFS opens at 11% discount. All you need to know
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India shares fell as the government plans a stake sale. The offer for sale opens for non-retail investors on July 4. Retail investors can participate in the stake sale on July 5. This divestment aims to increase LIC's public shareholding gradually. The government seeks to raise funds through this significant stake sale.

items.title: Paytm jumps over 4% after Rs 2,038-crore block deal; Saif Partners, Elevation Capital likely sellers
items.description: Paytm shares rose over 4% following a significant block deal. Early investors Saif Partners and Elevation Capital trimmed their holdings in the fintech firm. This secondary share sale involved approximately 2.3% of Paytm's outstanding equity. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings with increased net profit. Paytm's board also approved an additional investment into its subsidiary Paytm Money.

items.title: LTM among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
items.description: On August 03, five Nifty500 stocks that gained over 6% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: 9 microcap multibaggers: How India's stock market minnows beat every major index in six months
items.description: India's smallest listed stocks delivered the strongest market run in six months. The Nifty Microcap 250 index rose eleven percent, beating other size indices. Sterlite Technologies led gains with a four hundred twenty-four percent return. Fund managers expect earnings growth in smaller companies to improve soon. However, microcap stocks carry risks of sharp corrections and liquidity issues.

items.title: Block deal alert: Meesho shares in focus as Peak XV, Elevation Capital eye Rs 1,900 crore stake sale
items.description: Peak XV and Elevation Capital plan to sell a 2.3 per cent stake in Meesho via Rs 1,900 crore block deals. This follows Meesho narrowing its Q1 net loss to Rs 133 crore, while brokerages like Citi and Morgan Stanley remain divided on near-term growth dynamics.

items.title: Want Rs 10 crore for retirement in 20 years? How much you should SIP every month
items.description: Building a Rs 10 crore retirement fund in twenty years demands early and consistent monthly investments.  An investor can start with Rs 53,700 monthly and increase contributions by ten percent annually.  Factoring in inflation requires a higher starting SIP of Rs 85,000 with annual increases.  Equity mutual funds, particularly flexi-cap and mid-cap, are recommended for aggressive investors.  Consistent investing over two decades is the most crucial factor for reaching financial goals.

items.title: Urban Company among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 3, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 6% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels.“RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Vedanta Aluminium, Hyundai Motor among 25 stocks for dividend payout worth Rs 430
items.description: As per Sebi's T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action. Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy the shares so that they are credited to their accounts by Friday, making them eligible for the dividends.

items.title: Reliance Industries, ICICI Bank among 11 stocks with over 3% FY27 earnings upgrades. Own any?
items.description: Nifty companies have delivered a stronger-than-expected start to the first quarter earnings season, with profits of the 39 index constituents that have reported results so far rising 11% year on year, according to domestic brokerage Motilal Oswal. Here are the top 11 stocks where earnings upgrades have increased by more than 3% from Motilal Oswal.

items.title: Vedanta to demerge real estate business after 5-way split. What can shareholders expect?
items.description: Vedanta announced plans to demerge its real estate business into a new company. Shareholders will receive one share of Vedanta Property Platforms for every twenty shares held. This new entity will later debut on the stock exchanges, listing on BSE and NSE. The demerged real estate portfolio includes significant land and property assets across India. This move follows Vedanta's recent five-way business split, aiming to unlock shareholder value.
